# JEE College Predictor 2027

> Information, routes, and APIs for the JEE College Predictor application. This file serves as a guide for LLMs and developer agents to understand and interact with the site's data and structure.

JEE College Predictor is an advanced, free tool for Indian engineering aspirants to predict their admission chances into IITs, NITs, IIITs, and GFTIs through the JoSAA counseling process.

## Core Features

- **Accurate Predictions**: Uses official JoSAA cutoff data to match student ranks (JEE Main & JEE Advanced) with available branches.
- **AI Counseling**: Features "AI Counsellor", an integrated AI counselor powered by LLMs that answers specific questions about JoSAA rounds, college placements, branch preferences, and state/gender quotas.
- **Deep College Insights**: Provides detailed pages for each participating institute, including average/highest placement packages, annual fees, and complete opening/closing rank matrices.
- **College Comparison**: Allows side-by-side comparison of any two JoSAA institutes regarding branch-wise cutoffs, fees, and placements.

## Primary Routes & URLs

All routes are relative to the base URL: `https://jee-college-predictor-2027.vercel.appl.app`

- **Home Page** (`/`): The main predictor tool dashboard. Aspirants enter their rank, select exam type (JEE Main/Advanced), category (OPEN, OBC-NCL, SC, ST, EWS), gender, seat pool, and home state.
- **JoSAA Cutoff Explorer** (`/cutoffs`) compares programs across colleges and shows campus-specific cutoff history. See `/cutoffs/2026` for 2026 rounds and `/cutoffs/2025-vs-2026` for matched-round changes.
- **Colleges Directory** (`/colleges`): Complete searchable list of all IITs, NITs, IIITs, and GFTIs.
- **College Profile** (`/college/[slug]`): Specific profile for an institute (e.g., `/college/indian-institute-of-technology-bombay`). Contains branch-wise opening/closing ranks, average and highest packages, course fees, and total seat capacities.
- **Compare Tool** (`/compare`): Interface to select any two colleges for head-to-head comparison.
- **Programmatic SEO Comparison Pages** (`/compare/[college1-id]-vs-[college2-id]`): Side-by-side comparison page (e.g., `/compare/indian-institute-of-technology-bombay-vs-indian-institute-of-technology-delhi`) comparing placement packages, fees, and branch cutoffs.
- **AI Counselor Interface** (`/ai`): A full-screen interactive chatbot interface for custom admission counseling query resolution.

## APIs

Developers and agents can fetch data using the following endpoints:

- **Get College Details**: `GET /api/colleges/[id]`
  - Returns detailed profile, placements, fees, and branch cutoff matrix for the given college ID.
- **Run Predictor Query**: `GET /api/predict`
  - Query parameters: `rank`, `exam`, `category`, `gender` and `domicileState`.
  - Returns matching colleges and programs with estimated admission chances.
- **AI Chat Endpoint**: `POST /api/chat`
  - Session endpoint driving the Vercel AI SDK chat window with context about the user's predicted options.

## Data Sources & Accuracy

- **Cutoff Data**: Official JoSAA round-by-round statistics through the available 2026 rounds.
- **Placements & Fees**: Verified stats compiled from official institute placement reports and Senate fee brochures.
